summary: Tested live backend CRUD and frontend library, bilingual, saved, admin, responsive flows. Backend passed; frontend passed home/category/language/saved/admin category and exam flows. Paper creation flow was blocked by required year validation during the exercised submission.

integration_issues.issue: Submission remains in the modal with browser validation when year is blank; the tested form flow provides no explicit year interaction/default and therefore cannot complete unless the user discovers/fills the required year field.

action_items: Make the required year field clearly labeled and ensure the add-paper workflow captures/submits it; retest paper creation, bookmark, and official PDF opening afterward.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin submit has no error-state handling around axios.post/refresh, so API failures can leave the user without an explanatory message.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned TEST API category/exam/paper; UI test category and exam remained in the shared preview database because paper creation did not complete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home, category navigation, Hindi toggle, saved empty navigation, admin category/exam creation, and mobile no-overflow passed. Paper creation stopped at required year validation; official PDF opening and bookmark persistence with a created paper remain unverified.
rca of the issue: The Paper form renders a required type=number year input but the exercised flow did not populate it; native browser constraint validation prevents onSubmit, so the modal remains open and navigation is intercepted. Ensure the UI clearly exposes year and test with a valid year before evaluating downstream paper flows.
